:::{#exm-wilks-poisson}
#### Likelihood ratio test for a Poisson rate

For $\dsn{X} \siid \Pois(\rate)$
and $H_0: \rate = \rate_0$,
the log-likelihood is $\llik(\rate) = n\bar x \log\rate - n\rate - \sum_i \log x_i!$
and $\hat\rate_{\text{ML}} = \bar x$, so:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\Lambda
&= 2\paren{\llik(\bar x) - \llik(\rate_0)}
&& \text{(definition of $\Lambda$)}\\
&= 2\paren{\paren{n\bar x \log \bar x - n\bar x - \sum_i \log x_i!}
 - \paren{n\bar x \log\rate_0 - n\rate_0 - \sum_i \log x_i!}}
&& \text{(substitute $\llik(\bar x)$ and $\llik(\rate_0)$)}\\
&= 2\paren{n\bar x \log \bar x - n\bar x - \sum_i \log x_i!
 - n\bar x \log\rate_0 + n\rate_0 + \sum_i \log x_i!}
&& \text{(distribute the minus sign)}\\
&= 2\paren{n\bar x \log \bar x - n\bar x - n\bar x \log\rate_0 + n\rate_0}
&& \text{(the $\log x_i!$ terms cancel)}\\
&= 2n\paren{\bar x \log \bar x - \bar x - \bar x \log\rate_0 + \rate_0}
&& \text{(factor out $n$)}\\
&= 2n\paren{\bar x \log \bar x - \bar x \log\rate_0 - \bar x + \rate_0}
&& \text{(reorder the terms)}\\
&= 2n\paren{\bar x \paren{\log \bar x - \log\rate_0} - \bar x + \rate_0}
&& \text{(factor $\bar x$ out of the two log terms)}\\
&= 2n\paren{\bar x \log\frac{\bar x}{\rate_0} - \bar x + \rate_0}
&& \text{(log of a quotient)}
\end{aligned}
$$

For example, with $n = 13$, $\bar x = 72/13$, and $\rate_0 = 4$:

```{r}
#| code-fold: false
n_obs <- 13
xbar_obs <- 72 / 13
lambda0 <- 4
lr_stat <- 2 * n_obs *
  (xbar_obs * log(xbar_obs / lambda0) - xbar_obs + lambda0)
c(
  statistic = lr_stat,
  p_value = pchisq(lr_stat, df = 1, lower.tail = FALSE)
)
```

:::
